answer: A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The haven schedule is applied in reef and lotus exposes each instalment. A payout is split thus 39% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4381 identities would post 4943 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
